scope: APPROACH and ORIENT queries on explicit complete POSITION or XYZWPR values

reference_basis.documented: APPROACH returns the positive Z/approach VECTOR of POSITION; ORIENT returns the positive Y/orient VECTOR; direct POSITION field access is an alternative
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native XYZWPR overloads, partial-input behavior, tolerances, compiler and controller behavior remain unverified

implementation_choices.types: One exact POSITION or XYZWPR argument, transparent aliases included; VECTOR result; preserve internal routine signatures/effects and ordinary variable names
implementation_choices.mapping: Copy POSITION APPROACH or ORIENT columns directly; XYZWPR uses the third or second column of portable Rz(r) Ry(p) Rx(w); no intermediate POSITION Euler extraction
implementation_choices.validation: Complete finite exact pose, CONFIG and location; POSITION unit/orthogonal columns and determinant +1 with absolute 1e-9 tolerance under frame_policy; no normalization, repaired matrix or inferred axes
implementation_choices.ownership: Independent writable VECTOR; source POSITION orientation stays recursively read-only; temporary fields and VECTOR arguments own private writable storage
implementation_choices.effects: Evaluate operand once, detach axis before later expressions or assignment target effects; failure retains earlier effects, skips later effects and preserves destination; ordinary FOR and local-frame cleanup
implementation_choices.reports: Source-located position_axis_queries with function, body, actual operand type, result type and ownership/evaluation flags; position_axis_policy records current choices; field lookup does not duplicate sites

retained_boundaries: No XYZWPREXT/JOINTPOS/VECTOR or scalar operands, missing/default orientation or direct POSITION orientation writes
No controller acquisition, implicit frame context, external axes, native kinematics or robot configuration inference
Strict remains future work; authored fixtures and independent quaternion checks establish offline geometry only
